data.description:
Bug: Boss (The Central AI, GDD §4.3) dies with a single player bullet hit, whereas it should lose health phase-by-phase (4 phases) and change attack pattern until finally dead.

Root cause: GymFormationScene._handleCollisions calls entity.destroySelf() directly for all enemies, bypassing Boss.takeDamage() which implements the 4-phase health bar. Player bullet collision should delegate to Boss.takeDamage() so each hit decrements one health segment and advances phase, only destroying on the 4th hit.

AC:
- [ ] Boss requires 4 player bullet hits to destroy (each hit decrements one phase)
- [ ] Phase transitions update attack pattern and visuals after each hit
- [ ] DAMAGE button still works (already uses takeDamage)
- [ ] EXPLODE still insta-kills (admin action)
- [ ] Full test suite passes
data.title: Boss dies in single hit instead of 4-phase health
